children: Select Water Solutions agreed to acquire Pilot Water Solutions for $600 million in cash and $100 million in stock, with a $15 million contingent payment tied to operational milestones. The stock consideration will be based on the 30-day VWAP at closing, and a six-month price-protection true-up may result in additional cash paid to Pilot OFS. Closing is expected in Q4 2026, subject to customary approvals including HSR. Concurrently, SES Holdings obtained debt commitments from certain financing sources to fund the transaction.
